function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a file with line numbers. [PARALLEL-SAFE: can be batched with other independent tools in one response]

function.name: edit_code
function.description: Find-and-replace in an existing file. Matches old_string EXACTLY (including whitespace and indentation) and replaces with new_string. Auto-runs jac_check on .jac files after the edit. This returned check is authoritative — do NOT re-validate the same file via `jac_check` or a `jac check` run_command afterward; W-code warnings are non-blocking noise. Call read_file first if you're unsure of the exact existing content — mismatches are the #1 cause of edit_code failures. [PARALLEL-SAFE: can be batched with other independent tools in one response]

file_path.description: Absolute path to the existing file.

old_string.description: REQUIRED. Exact substring to match, including whitespace and indentation. Must be unique in the file unless replace_all=True. Copy it verbatim from read_file output — do not paraphrase.

new_string.description: Replacement text. May be an empty string to delete the matched span. May be multi-line.

replace_all.description: If True, replace every occurrence. Defaults to False — matches must be unique in that mode.

function.name: write_code
function.description: Write or overwrite a file with the given content. Auto-runs jac_check on .jac files, blocks known anti-patterns, returns errors for you to fix in follow-up calls. This returned check is authoritative — after writing, do NOT re-validate the same file via `jac_check` or a `jac check` run_command; W-code warnings are non-blocking noise, not something to re-inspect. ALWAYS call with BOTH file_path AND content. Never call with content omitted, empty, or containing placeholders like '<rest of code>' — emit the COMPLETE file text every call. [PARALLEL-SAFE: can be batched with other independent tools in one response]

file_path.description: Absolute path to the file. Any existing file at this path is overwritten.

content.description: REQUIRED. The complete text to write — no placeholders, no truncation, no '// ...'. Must be a non-empty string. If the file is too large to fit in one call, split it into multiple smaller files instead of truncating.

function.name: run_command
function.description: Run a shell command with permission check. [PARALLEL-SAFE: can be batched with other independent tools in one response]
